name: FlowBench
description: FlowBench is the first benchmark for workflow-guided planning in LLM-based agents, covering 51 scenarios across 6 domains with diverse workflow knowledge formats to evaluate planning reliability and efficacy.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the original paper, with limited but growing use in LLM-agent planning research.
notes: Formalizes workflow knowledge formats and assesses current LLM agents' planning capabilities.
